title: Photo ring spin and column dive
summary: Portrait photos float on true black in 3D: first a ring of cards turns past the camera, then a hard cut drops into a deep column of cards. Each shot is one eased in-out move, so the parallax reads like a real camera.
use_when: A gallery, portfolio or image product that needs its pictures to carry the frame
An interlude or opener between scenes of a longer film
Silent autoplay where bright imagery on black has to hold attention
A looping background for a landing page hero

sfx.event: hard cut into the card column (6.40 s)

structure.shot: about 8 portrait photo cards on a horizontal ring seen from slightly above: near row big and low, far row small and high, black
structure.camera: ring rotation starts from rest: near-row shift -3 px/0.1 s at 0.5 s, -9 at 1.0 s (human 30 fps study); inOutSine ramp-in
structure.motion: cards billboarded, no own animation; whole move easings.inOutSine over the shot (192 fr); near row drifts left, far row right

structure.shot: the ring turns fast: near cards slide left out of frame, new cards come round from the right and rise into the near row
structure.camera: ring turn at peak: near row >= 800 px/s at 720p, far row ~640-690 px/s opposite (human 30 fps study), motion.json pan up to -779 px/s @1920
structure.motion: same single easings.inOutSine move, peak 2.5-4.0 s; near/far speed ratio 1.3-1.7, near/far height ratio ~1.85; no blur

structure.shot: the ring slows and settles back into the opening arrangement (6.00 s cell matches 0.00 s)
structure.camera: ring turn decelerates: near row -60 px/0.1 s at 4.5 s, -27 at 5.0, -9 at 5.5, -2 at 6.0 (human 30 fps study)
structure.motion: tail of the easings.inOutSine move, settled by ~6.0 s (+-0.25 s); about 12 fr of near-still hold before the cut

structure.shot: new layout: about 6 smaller cards scattered through a deep column with wide black gaps, some cropped at the frame edges
structure.camera: near still 6.40-7.00 s (motion.json 6-7 s pan ~0), then the camera starts to sink through the column; inOutSine ramp-in
structure.motion: cards billboarded; one easings.inOutSine move over the shot (191 fr); cards begin to stream up and right

structure.shot: cards stream up and to the right past the camera, near cards grow and leave the top edge, new ones enter from below
structure.camera: dive at peak 9-10 s: motion.json pan +668 / -931 px/s @1920, zoom +16.6 %/s; depth by scale and parallax only
structure.motion: same easings.inOutSine move, peak 9-10 s (+-0.25 s); near cards ~0.45 H, far ~0.2 H tall

structure.shot: the column slows and settles into a layout matching the first frame after the cut (12.50 s cell matches 6.50 s)
structure.camera: dive decelerates: motion.json 11-12 s pan ~300 px/s, 12-12.77 s ~10 px/s; settled by ~12.5 s (human 30 fps study)
structure.motion: tail of the easings.inOutSine move; ~8 fr near-still at the end (+-0.25 s)

params.brand: any brand.json: bg (near-black works best), accent for the faint centre glow
params.content.images: 8-12 portrait images, ~3:4, bright and saturated; they are the light source
params.timing.shotFrames: frames per shot at 30 fps (default 192); each shot is one inOutSine move
params.shots: 1 or 2: ring turn, then column dive
params.rimLight: white glint on the top edge of each card, 0 = off

notes: Silent reference: sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Speeds, card sizes and the in-out profile come from the human 30 fps study; sheet resolution is 0.25 s. Each shot is one eased in-out move (not linear), peak mid-shot, ~0 at both ends; each shot ends on its own first frame, so a single shot loops, the whole film does not (loopable false). Near and far rows move in opposite directions from one projection: never fake parallax with per-layer speeds. No depth-of-field blur: depth is scale, overlap and parallax only. Cards: square corners, no border, bright rim glint on top edges, thin blue fringe on some left edges. Ring turn without a core is a proposed term (image-ring-spin); difficulty hard because the cards live in a 3D space (measure.md §10: any 3D), even though the projection is 2.5D (DepthField/project). All rows are hook by the beat rules (no product, text or mark appears). Spring/easing choice inOutSine is a default matched to the measured speed profile.
